lines.text: Claude Code can run a whole task on its own.
So you hand it one, and get on with your day.
Soon you have three, four, five sessions running.
And somewhere in there, one of them is waiting for you.
It floats above every app on your Mac, and keeps an eye on all of them.
It shows you who's working, who's finished, and who needs you.
One finishes: it smiles and waves.
One needs you: it hops and chimes.
Hover to see every session. Click to jump straight in.
Four characters, nine behaviours, twelve faces.
No hooks. No settings to change. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Claude does the work. Vertex keeps you in the loop.
